title: A little direction. A lot to discover.
intro: Explore two schematic floors, choose an artifact, or follow your personal tour.
notice: Schematic demo — not an official floor plan or live position. Locations and routes are illustrative. Ask museum staff for actual directions.
mapDescription: Select an artifact. The list below offers the same keyboard controls. Dashed lines show the tour.
accessibleRoute: Uses the schematic lift and returns to the entrance. Confirm real access with staff.
routeHelp: Follow the numbered stops via the central connector. The route returns to the entrance.
noRoute: Create a tour to add a suggested order.
invalidRoute: Those stops are unavailable. Create a new tour.
listIntro: Choose an artifact for the same details available on the map.
